scripts.dev: pnpm services:up && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @omniva/api db:migrate && pnpm --parallel --filter @omniva/api --filter @omniva/web run dev
scripts.services:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis mailpit minio && docker compose up -d clamav
scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @omniva/api db:generate && pnpm --filter @omniva/domain-types --filter @omniva/schemas build && pnpm --filter @omniva/api openapi:generate && pnpm --filter @omniva/api-client generate && pnpm build:packages
scripts.test: pnpm test:seam2 && pnpm test:seam1 && pnpm test:seam3
scripts.check:generated: pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/generated
